newsitem.title: USA: Cyclone Justin dissipating, rains continue - WSC.
newsitem.headline: Cyclone Justin dissipating, rains continue - WSC.

text.p: Heavy rains along the coast of southern Queensland from Tropical Cyclone Justin will continue for the next 12 hours, which may lead to some additional flooding, independent forecaster Weather Services Corp said on Monday.
Justin is near the coast of southern Queensland and moving towards the east-southeast, WSC said.
It will be a decreasing risk to shipping as it dissipates during the next 24-36 hours, when it should be over water to the east of the Australian coast.
The hardest hit areas during the weekend were to the north near Townsville, Cairns and Cooktown where heavy rain caused flooding.
